rules.statement: The relationship of landlord and tenant expires at the end of a lease term, and thereafter the parties are in the position of owner and trespasser, with no application of the Rent Restriction Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a person enters into a lease for a definite term it seems to me that the relationship of landlords and tenant expires at the end of the term, and it cannot therefore be said that there is tenancy as between the parties. I am, therefore, of the opinion that the Rent Restriction Ordinance has no application in this case.

meta.parties: Asia Umma Et Al. v. Cader Lebbe
